facts.fact: The Lesotho Times reports Lesotho took part in Smart Africa's Data Value Creation Blueprint programme, holding a national validation workshop in Maseru with Smart Africa and GIZ, and a Smart Africa representative said Lesotho joined the programme after other countries (workshop date not given; published date 2026-09-17 used).
